actions.description: Capture a depth point cloud over a declared range and return a point-cloud artifact reference with the point count and coordinate frame.
actions.name: capture_point_cloud

facts.text: The package describes its supported sensors as all models of the OS-x from 16 to 128 beams running firmware 2.2-2.4.
PointcloudProcessor sizes the cloud from the sensor metadata's pixels_per_column and columns_per_frame fields.
PointcloudProcessor creates a sensor_msgs::msg::PointCloud2 publisher on the relative topic name points with the configured QoS.
PointcloudProcessor::process returns without publishing until the full-rotation accumulator reports a complete batch.
PointcloudProcessor builds an XYZ lookup from the sensor metadata and, when a full rotation is ready, calls toCloud with that lookup, the accumulated scan and the cloud buffer.
PointcloudProcessor publishes the selected cloud through the PointCloud2 publisher using the accumulated scan timestamp and the _frame member.
The PointCloud2 conversion assigns its frame argument to header.frame_id and derives header.stamp from the timestamp and override timestamp arguments.
OusterDriver::onActivate activates every data processor and starts the receive and process threads; onDeactivate clears the processing flag, joins both threads and deactivates the processors.
The upstream launch file names the lifecycle node ouster_driver and gives it the root namespace /.
OusterDriver creates its reset and get_metadata services on the private names ~/reset and ~/get_metadata.
OusterDriver creates the data processors with shared_from_this() and rclcpp::SensorDataQoS(), or with rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS() when use_system_default_qos is set.
